//: What scripts/check/package-graph.sh allows in the packages under Packages/ (AGENTS.md Rules 1, 2, 21 and 22). Setup created this file once; it is yours now.
//layers: Each library target, and the targets of its own package it may import. A target missing here fails the check: add it with its allowed imports when you add it to Package.swift. Features never import each other.
//plugins: Build-tool plugins and macros run third-party code in every build. Each one a target uses is named here with the decision that allowed it (a sentence and a link to the ADR); anything unnamed fails.
